claim: Wednesday 11 November is the day on which the European Commission and its agencies run most of their sessions at the summit.
The European Commission and its agencies have four of the seven sessions on their agenda on Wednesday 11 November, with two on Tuesday and one on Thursday.
The session 'Building AI in Europe: Practical support for innovators' runs from 14:30 to 15:15 in Masterclass 3 and is run by the European Commission, DG CONNECT.
The session 'Investing in technological sovereignty: EU funding for your project' runs from 15:30 to 16:15 and features four EU-funded projects, run by HaDEA.
The EuroHPC session on using Europe's supercomputers, AI Factories and quantum computers for free runs from 16:00 to 16:45, on a first come, first served basis.
The HaDEA session (15:30 to 16:15) and the EuroHPC session (16:00 to 16:45) overlap by a quarter of an hour.
The 'European Tech Champions, Italy and Portugal' event in Beato starts from 18:30 and is run by Unicorn Factory Lisboa, the Embassy of Italy and ICE.
The EUIPO panel on how IP-backed finance can help companies raise money and scale is scheduled at 12:10.
The session 'The next digital frontier' runs from 10:30 to 10:50 on Stage 11 and includes Portugal's Secretary of State for Digitalisation.
HaDEA's stand is E418 in Pavilion 4, and HaDEA says it is staffed throughout the summit.
Only the AI masterclass and 'The next digital frontier' were found on Web Summit's schedule when it was read on 6 November.
The article's first version was published on 7 November 2026 at 02:50 UTC.
